name: Sakoda Ken
source:
"A low-level yakuza and underling of Sakyo Furuichi, who he calls "aniki" or "bro". He's extremely devoted to Sakyo, and is often seen helping him with various tasks and hanging around the company. As a result, he gets quite familiar with the members of MANKAI."

[From the [url=https://yaycupcake.com/a3/index.php?title=Other_Characters#tab=MANKAI_Company_and_Affiliates]A3! Wiki[/url]]
